response.overview: In an unknown future, humanity is no longer what it once was. Sex is the new currency, and desire has become the economy. Three lives collide under a regime that controls even intimacy itself. Pedro survives ruin without money or hope, Ana seeks in fertility the success the system denies her, and Marcos conspires from the shadows to bring it all down. Three fragmented stories from a single world breathing oppression, desire, and rebellion. A glimpse into the dawn of a revolution where the price of being human has never been higher.
